chunks: People are like mines, just as gold and silver mines.

key_terms.الْفِضَّةِ: silver; a symbol of precious value
key_terms.اَلذَّهَبِ: gold; a symbol of precious value
key_terms.مَعَادِنُ: mines; hidden sources of valuable qualities

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "People are like mines" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that people possess differing inner qualities and capacities, just as mines contain different precious substances. It highlights the noble potential and distinct worth found among human beings in a concise prophetic expression.
